title: Team Broadcast
desc: Instantly broadcast critical alerts and updates to your entire workforce. Team Broadcast sends a push notification directly to employees' mobile devices via the Peoplesafe app.
content:
Instantly broadcast critical alerts and updates to your entire workforce, regardless of their location, ensuring everyone is informed and can take appropriate action.

Team Broadcast sends a push notification directly to employees’ mobile devices via our lone worker apps, which can be configured to override Do Not Disturb settings.

The process of receiving the message, reading it and acknowledging receipt will all be tracked in Nexus so you can quickly see who is aware of a developing situation and make a priority list of people to contact. During emergencies like facility incidents, severe weather, or security threats, time is of the essence.

Send messages to specific individuals, Teams, or Groups, allowing for precise communication and minimising unnecessary alerts. This granular control ensures relevant information reaches the right people at the right time.

Whether your workforce is on-site, remote, or spread across multiple locations, Team Broadcast ensures your messages reach everyone they need to, eliminating gaps and ensuring consistent safety protocols.

Nexus admins can log into the Nexus portal and compose a message to deliver to your employees.

When composing the message, it will consist of a summary, a short message, and then a more detailed message. You can then select who you want to send it to whether that’s a Group, a specific Team or certain individuals.

Once the message has sent, it will pop up on the user’s lock screen of their phone to give them a summary of the message and the title. When the user logs into their Peoplesafe app, they can read the full detail of the message and acknowledge it.
